page.notes: Arabic and Hebrew-script passages are copied from the scan as far as legible; the Arabic word forms in the notes and in the text are uncertain in places and may contain errors. The right-margin note "ح. ص lib. الرن &c." is doubtful. The Latin "Maledicti" and "Iabarii" are read as printed but are uncertain. The line "ex Al-" ends the page with a hyphen; the catchword "corano" completes it on the next page. Note placement is approximate: the first marginal note is beside the "Felix" line, the second beside the Arabic "Maledicti" line.
